title: Efficient Program Reduction for Library Fuzzing Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.23054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Library fuzzing harnesses translate generated inputs into API calls. When a complex harness triggers a crash, developers must determine whether the cause is a library defect or invalid harness usage. A smaller reproducer can simplify this investigation, but obtaining one requires repeatedly building and executing modified harnesses and analyzing their crashes, making manual or even automatic minimization time-consuming. Moreover, data-dependent statements prevent the reducer to remove unnecessary code and the heavy stack trace symbolization in libraries also slows down the candidate execution. To address these challenges, we present HarnessMinimizer, a system for efficient minimization of C/C++ library fuzzing harnesses. Its optimized pipeline reuses header analysis and prepared libraries and runtimes to reduce the work required to build and execute each simplified harness during the reduction process. It records and replays input values

translated_title: 面向库模糊测试工具的高效程序精简
translated_abstract: 库模糊测试工具将生成的输入转化为API调用。当复杂的测试工具触发崩溃时，开发人员必须确定原因是库本身的缺陷还是工具的无效使用。一个更小的复现程序可以简化这一调查过程，但获得它需要反复构建和执行修改后的测试工具并分析其崩溃，使得手动甚至自动化的精简过程非常耗时。此外，数据依赖的语句会阻碍精简器删除不必要的代码，而库中繁重的堆栈跟踪符号化也会拖慢候选程序的执行速度。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HarnessMinimizer，一个用于高效精简C/C++库模糊测试工具的系统。其优化的流水线通过复用头文件分析结果以及预先准备的库和运行时，减少了精简过程中构建和执行每个简化测试工具所需的工作量。该系统还会记录并重放输入值。
tldr: 本文提出HarnessMinimizer系统，通过复用头文件分析和预编译的库与运行时来高效精简C/C++库模糊测试工具，帮助开发者快速判断崩溃源于库缺陷还是工具误用。
en_tdlr: HarnessMinimizer is a system for efficiently minimizing C/C++ library fuzzing harnesses by reusing header analysis and prebuilt libraries and runtimes to accelerate the build and execution of simplified harness candidates during reduction.
